table.name: profiles
table.description: Extends Supabase auth.users with marketplace metadata

column.name: id
column.description: Referential link matching the Supabase internal authentication ID

column.name: email
column.description: Verified user email address matching the login register flow

column.name: role
column.description: Marketplace access level scoping: designer (Originator), buyer (Mill Master), or explorer (Sandbox)

column.name: has_accepted_tc
column.description: Verification signoff indicating user accepted the PEAL copyright broker rules

column.name: name
column.description: Full name or display name of the user

column.name: bio
column.description: Short biography or statement from the user

column.name: organization
column.description: Associated studio, weaving mill, or enterprise brand name

column.name: region
column.description: Geographic or physical operational region of the brand/designer

column.name: created_at
column.description: System record timestamps in UTC time

policy.name: Allow public read access to profiles
Allow users to insert their own profile
Allow users to update their own profile

table.name: designs
table.description: Textile patterns catalog index, featuring protected preview resources

column.name: designer_id
column.description: Unique ID of the designer who owns the intellectual property

column.name: title
column.description: Name of the repeating tile artwork

column.name: tags
column.description: Array of classification tags like Silk, Linen, Cyberpunk for search index matching

column.name: preview_url
column.description: URL to low-resolution preview image with right-edge pixel guard lock

column.name: master_url
column.description: URL to layered high-resolution PSD or TIFF archive encrypted and held in escrow

column.name: base_price
column.description: Floor USD price required by the designer to release the escrow print package

column.name: max_discount_pct
column.description: The maximum proportional discount percentage the designer's royalties will accept

column.name: is_active
column.description: Status indicator allowing designers to temporarily archive catalog displays

policy.name: Allow public read access to active designs
Allow designers to insert their own designs
policy.using: auth.uid() = designer_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'designer')

policy.name: Allow designers to update their own designs
Allow designers to delete their own designs

table.name: vault_items
table.description: Temporary staging table representing shopping carts staged for contract volume calculation

policy.name: Allow buyers to manage their own vault

table.name: transactions
table.description: Compiled contracts representing cleared purchases and volume agreements

policy.name: Allow buyers to view their own transactions

table.name: transaction_items
table.description: Individual purchases cataloged inside cleared contracts

policy.name: Allow buyers to view their own transaction items
policy.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE id = transaction_items.transaction_id AND buyer_id = auth.uid())

policy.name: Allow buyers to insert transaction items
policy.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE id = transaction_items.transaction_id AND buyer_id = auth.uid())

trigger.name: on_auth_user_created
trigger.function: BEGIN INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, role, has_accepted_tc, name, bio, organization, region) VALUES ( NEW.id, NEW.email, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'buyer'), FALSE, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1)), COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'bio', ''), COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'organization', ''), COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'region', '') ); RETURN NEW; END;
